submission.justification:
Mixture-G1 with a 2mm gas gap achieves the best time resolution of 0.89 ns among all tested configurations. This configuration meets all project requirements:

1. Time Resolution Performance: Mixture-G1 significantly outperforms the alternatives across all gap sizes tested (1mm, 2mm, and 3mm). At the optimal 2mm gap:
   - Mixture-G1: 0.89 ns (best)
   - Mixture-G3: 1.348 ns (51% worse)
   - Mixture-G2: 2.052 ns (130% worse)

2. Gap Selection: The 2mm gap represents the optimal balance for Mixture-G1, providing better resolution than either 1mm (1.022 ns) or 3mm (1.015 ns) configurations, while remaining well within the required 1-3mm range.

3. Compliance: The recommended configuration satisfies all constraints including mixture candidacy, environmental/safety policies (90% gas recirculation available), operational voltage limits (HV max 12 kV), and gap specifications.

This recommendation delivers the best possible time resolution as required by the project goal, with Mixture-G1 at 2mm gap providing superior performance across the entire parameter space explored.
